components_code_editor_setbuffer: A CodeMirror helper that sets an internal token/cursor buffer, used alongside cursor set/get routines.
components_code_editor_setheight: A CodeMirror rendering helper that stores a measured element height for layout balancing.
components_code_editor_setlookahead: A Lezer LR-parser helper that records a lookahead token during error recovery and action resolution.
components_code_editor_setorder: A minified CodeMirror facet/state-update helper that sets ordering information in the editor state.
components_code_editor_setwindow: A CodeMirror DOM helper that sets the root window, attaching or removing window-level event listeners.
components_code_editor_skip: A Lezer tokenizer helper that advances the scanner past characters that should be skipped (e.g. whitespace).
components_code_editor_sm: A Lezer tree-building helper that adds gaps and converts buffered tokens into a syntax tree.
components_code_editor_span: A CodeMirror decoration helper that flushes and yields spans/points during range iteration.
components_code_editor_sq: A minified CodeMirror constructor/helper class in the code-editor bundle.
components_code_editor_ss: A minified CodeMirror constructor that adds DOM/window event listeners for the editor view.
components_code_editor_startparse: A Lezer/CodeMirror language helper that begins a new parse of the document, creating a parse context.
components_code_editor_startupdate: A minified CodeMirror facet/field helper that begins a state or query update.
components_code_editor_stopat: A Lezer parser helper that halts parsing at a given position, used with the skipping parser.
components_code_editor_suppresswidgetcur: A CodeMirror view helper that prevents cursor-change handling from firing while a widget's DOM is being updated.
components_code_editor_t: A minified CodeMirror helper related to word lookup at a position.
components_code_editor_tc: A minified CodeMirror helper that adds, replaces, and sorts entries in a collection (e.g. decorations or ranges).
components_code_editor_textafterpos: A CodeMirror helper that returns the text following a given document position.
components_code_editor_th: A minified Lezer LR-parser advancement helper in the code-editor bundle.
components_code_editor_tocontextpos: A CodeMirror helper that converts a position into context-relative coordinates, used when reverting pending edits.
components_code_editor_tokenbefore: A CodeMirror language helper that returns the syntax token immediately preceding a given position.
components_code_editor_ug: A minified Lezer parser helper used in stack creation/splitting during parsing.
components_code_editor_unquote: A CodeMirror helper that removes surrounding quote characters from matched text, used in autocomplete replacement.
components_code_editor_updatelinegaps: A CodeMirror rendering helper that recalculates line gaps after a view/document update.
components_code_editor_updaterange: A CodeMirror decoration helper that updates a decoration range after a document change.
components_code_editor_updatescaler: A CodeMirror rendering helper that recalculates scaling factors used for viewport measurement.
components_code_editor_updatespacer: A CodeMirror rendering helper that updates the spacer element sizing after a view update.
components_code_editor_vd: A minified CodeMirror facet/state definition helper in the code-editor bundle.
components_code_editor_vi: A minified Lezer tokenizer helper related to peeking at upcoming characters during scanning.
components_code_editor_viewportisappropr: A CodeMirror rendering helper that checks whether the current rendered viewport still matches the visible area.
components_code_editor_wm: A minified CodeMirror helper that slices and replaces content at a line position.
components_code_editor_wp: A minified CodeMirror helper that reads document text via sliceDoc, used with markdown parsing helpers.
components_code_editor_xd: A minified CodeMirror keydown-handling helper in the code-editor bundle.
components_code_editor_yf: A minified CodeMirror helper that converts between screen coordinates and document positions.
components_code_editor_yieldnode: A syntax-tree iterator helper that yields the current node and moves to its parent.
components_code_editor_yu: A minified CodeMirror facet/state helper function in the code-editor bundle.
components_code_editor_yy: A minified Lezer LR-parser advancement helper, paired with th().
components_file_upload_c: A minified helper function in the Filament file-upload component's bundled JS.
components_file_upload_clickpercent: An audio/video waveform timeline helper in the file-upload component that converts a click position into a percentage of the timeline, used for scrubbing playback.
components_file_upload_de: A minified helper function in the file-upload component's bundled JS.
components_file_upload_moveplayhead: A media preview helper in the file-upload component that moves the playhead position when the user interacts with the timeline.
